programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Swallows and Amazons
programme.desc: Four children dream of escaping the tedium of a summer holiday with their mother. When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed. But when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale

programme.title: Beauty And the Beast
programme.desc: A widowed merchant moves to the countryside with his six children after going bankrupt. His youngest daughter, Belle, is the only one happy with the change. When the merchant's lost ship is found, he plans to reclaim his assets. On the way, he encounters the Beast's magical domain, where his needs are met. However, he is caught picking a rose and must return to the castle or his family will be killed. Feeling responsible, Belle offers herself in her father's place.

programme.title: Nightcap
programme.desc: In Lausanne, the aspirant pianist Jeanne Pollet has lunch with her mother Louise Pollet, her boyfriend Axel and his mother. Lenna leans that when she was born, a nurse had mistakenly told to the prominent pianist André Polonski that she would be his daughter. André has just remarried his first wife, the heiress of a Swiss chocolate factory Marie-Claire "Mika" Muller and they live in Lausanne with André's son Guillaume Polonski. Out of the blue, Jeanne visits André and he offers to give piano classes to help her in her examination. Jeanne becomes closer to André and sooner she discovers that Mika might be drugging her stepson with Rohypnol. Further, she might have killed his second wife Lisbeth.

programme.title: Hannes
programme.desc: Born at the same place, on the same day, Hannes and Moritz grow up to be inseparable friends. But one day a tragic motorcycle accident will change their lives forever, leaving Hannes in a coma with a slim chance of recovery. Moritz refuses to give up on his friend and puts his own life aside to ensure Hannes is always loved and surrounded by life and laughter. Trying to stand his ground, Moritz will then embark on an inspiring and life-changing journey, realizing that every day is worth celebrating and proving their friendship is stronger than ever.

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy from director Charles Crichton. Alec Guinness stars as a mild-mannered transporter of gold bullion. He has been doing the job for the past 20 years honestly enough, but suddenly decides to steal a million pounds. He enlists the help of paperweight manufacturer Stanley Holloway and the men hijack the bank's armoured car. Once in their hands, the gold bars are melted down and formed into small, souvenir Eiffel Towers. But after the booty is smuggled out to Paris, it is purchased by a group of English schoolgirls. As a result of their pleading with the girls, the gang retrieve all but one of the towers. But the last one is in the hands of a very determined student, and she refuses to part with it... With Sid James, Alfie Bass and Majorie Fielding.

programme.title: The Nannies
programme.desc: Angèle, a thirty-something from Ivory Coast, always cope thanks to the gift of gab and audacity. To escape from a bunch of dangerous criminals, she becomes a nanny in the uptown Paris, hired by Hélène, the single mom of eight years old Arthur. Discovering the work conditions of her colleagues, she decides to stand up for their rights, thanks to a young lawyer who will quickly fall for her.

programme.title: No Chains No Masters
programme.desc: On a island controlled by French settlers in 1759, Massamba accepts his fate as a slave but his daughter Mati flees from the plantation. He has no choice but to break his chains and set off on a desperate search for her.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: When Connor MacLeod is wounded in battle but does not die, he's exiled from his homeland as unnatural.

programme.title: Breakfast on Pluto
programme.desc: Set in the 1970s, "Breakfast on Pluto" follows the exploits of Patrick Braden (Cillian Murphy), an endearing, witty, clever and deceptively tough young transvestite. Abandoned as a baby in his small Irish hometown, Patrick is aware from a very early age that he has been born into the wrong body. He survives this harsh environment with the aid of his wit and charm, plus a sweet refusal to let anyone and anything change who he is. With a burning desire to find his mother and reconciliation, he moves to London, and a hilarious, memorable and emotional series of misadventures sees Patrick, or Kitten as he prefers to be called, finally finding the love and happiness he craves.

programme.title: Family Life
programme.desc: A young man spends a few weeks housekeeping for a distant relative. Soon, he meets a cute neighbor and starts pretending for his personal benefit.

programme.title: Meet the Penguins
programme.desc: Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That?
programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Wild Dubai
programme.desc: Wild Dubai explores the vast – often hidden – wildlife of the largest city in the United Arab Emirates, as it journeys through the traditions of camel racing and falconry, reflecting the impact of heritage on the commitment to protect the wider environment and its wildlife.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: This time we are off to Nevada on the hunt for the Camel Spider. This arachnid, sometimes called a wind scorpion, is neither a true spider nor a scorpion. Only 6 inches long, they a voracious feeders and prey on termites, darkling beetles and other ground dwelling insects. This little giant has been known to feed on snakes, small lizards, birds and rodents. They do not normally attack humans, but when they do, their bite can be extremely painful.

programme.title: Little Giants
programme.desc: When one thinks of dominant animals that roam the earth, large predators - lions, grizzlies and titanic anacondas come to mind. But, pound for pound, the most powerful and awe-inspiring creatures are the elusive micro-monsters that exist just beneath our feet. Wildlife author & expert Bradley Trevor Greive and biodesigner Billy Almon venture to some of the most remote and inhospitable habitats in the world to track down these tiny beasts. Using state of the art equipment, they will measure the abilities of these creatures and present them in a way never seen before.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Extinct or Alive
programme.desc: Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The first day of darkness has arrived at the refuge. Now, the days are growing shorter, causing Bob, Heimo and the Lewis family to set additional traps and continue hunting for food. Heimo uses what little daylight there is to catch his biggest adversary and competition for resources - the wolf. But overflow on the river blocks his path home and jeopardizes his golden rule of surviving the winter: "Always return home before the faint light of day is gone." Bob returns to the refuge from town and begins to follow fresh animal tracks as a result of the constant snowfall. Ray's daughters, Emma, Sarah and Molly, become emotional after what might be their last winter at the refuge as a family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Big Fish Man
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Traveling back in time has never tasted so good. In this battle of the Chopped: Time Capsule series, the competing chefs have to cook with foods that were popular in the 1960s. A certain soda and some sweet meat are part of the appetizer basket, but the clock seems to be the most difficult aspect of the challenge. In the second round, a crazy casserole demands the chefs' attention, and in the dessert round, both chefs seem to have a clear plan, but will all of their ideas make it to the plate?

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Primal Instinct
programme.desc: In this true-crime documentary series we explore gruesome murders that have transpired after relationships, flings and affairs have turned sour. Using reenactments, each episode graphically details the motives behind the murders, revealing how the relationships spiralled out of control and left someone dead. We follow the story of a different murder in each episode, whether it's jealous ex-lovers, paranoid husbands or resentful mistresses. These real life stories show the darker side of love and the deception it can lead to.

programme.title: Crime Scene Confidential
programme.desc: Alina Burroughs investigates the evidence in some truly baffling murder cases ranging from a deadly fall from a balcony that turns out to be even more twisted than initially thought, to the case of the unexpected death of a young college student that was believed to be closed. From the unknown to the sensational, Burroughs uses her years of training to see the clues and uncover the mysteries that only an expert C.S.I. could catch, while also having emotional, and sometimes tense, conversations with both the victim's loved ones, and, at times, even the suspected or convicted perpetrator to understand more about the case.

programme.desc: True-crime programme that explores a number of shocking cases of dangerous obsessions, violence and even murder that are connected with high school football, and which occured in communities acros the USA where football is everything. Series uses archival footage and interviews with people connected to the crimes, to tell various hair-raising stories of cheerleaders gone missing, upcoming football stars who get gunned down, local authorities covering up for their best player, and more.

programme.title: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights
programme.desc: When the Denver Broncos draft Texas high school football star Darrent Williams in 2005, he stays loyal to his hometown and begins his professional football career with the Broncos. On New Year's Eve, December 31, 2006, Williams flies five school friends to Denver, Colorado for a party. Soon after midnight, on January 1, 2007, a vehicle pulled up beside Williams' rented Hummer H2 limousine in downtown Denver. Williams and two other passengers were shot. Williams was killed during this drive-by shooting at approximately 2:10 AM. The two other passengers injured in the shooting were both released from the hospital the day after. Nobody knows who killed Williams, or why.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Documentary series that tells true and often tragic stories of the crimes perpetrated on the internet and of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions - from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to maniacs searching for their victims in chat rooms. Series includes re-enactments, comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts, psychologists and interviews from friends and families of the victims. Rare episodes feature victims who were extremely lucky to survive and are able to tell us what happened.

programme.title: Where Murder Lies
programme.desc: When a mother of three goes missing, the entire town of Renovo, Pennsylvania, searches far and wide for her. Eventually, two suspicious ransom notes and a chase across state borders lead police to a suspect who was under their noses the entire time.

Detailing how she solved each crime, and revealing how she convinced the most cold-blooded killers to confess, Detective Gligorijevic knows she can't bring closure to someone who's lost a loved one to murder, but she'll stop at nothing to get them justice.

programme.title: Salvage Dawgs
programme.desc: Salvage Dawgs is a trip into a world of shrewd negotiations as Robert Kulp and Mike Whiteside — co-owners of one of the premier architectural salvage operations in the United States, Black Dog Salvage — bid on homes and buildings condemned to be demolished. Their goal is to secure the remarkable pieces of America's past hidden inside these old structures before they are lost forever. These salvaged vintage pieces include everything from doors, windows, mantels and more. Once they are recovered, the guys sell these valuable pieces to a wide range of clients, from construction workers to high-end interior designers, who use them to restore other historical buildings and add character to newer structures.

Gates begins by interviewing key eyewitnesses and uncovering recent developments in the story, then springboards into a fully immersive exploration. This authentic, roughshod adventure leads Gates closer to the truth behind these unanswered global enigmas, such as the disappearance of Amelia Earhart's plane. Josh Gates is an adventurer and avid explorer with a unique brand of humor and passion for off-the-map excursions.

programme.title: Lost Monster Files
programme.desc: For centuries, Arkansas locals have shared stories of a mysterious reptile called the Gowrow that hunts prey in the caves along the White River. A 12-foot monster with a long tail and sharp teeth, it is said to stand on its hind legs and release a loud hunting call that echoes throughout the nearby hollers. Armed with a series of accounts from Ivan Sanderson, the team investigates recent sightings of this creature to determine if it is merely folklore or an ancient reptilian predator that has survived in the underground chambers of the Ozark Caverns.

programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: American Loggers
programme.desc: The rain has finally stopped so it's time to get the wood to the mill. Pelletier Inc. is falling behind on its weekly quota so Eldon takes a big risk. Doubling the danger, Eldon hitches a second trailer to his truck and heads out on to the Golden Road - an experiment the other drivers think is nuts. Eldon is determined and looks to prove it can be done.

programme.title: American Loggers
programme.desc: A hurricane hits, creating near impossible logging conditions all week. First, the Pelletiers have to deal with an overloaded trailer spilling its contents and cutting off logging traffic from Telos to Canada. Then, the worsening rain and mud force the family to shut down operations for a day - a huge financial blow.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Extreme Engineering
programme.desc: Each episode of Extreme Engineering discussed some major construction project, some of them are projects that have already been completed like Hong Kong's airport. Others talked abount projects that are currently under construction like Tuneling Under the Alps. And some episodes talked about more futuristic projects that may never be done like the Transatlantic Tunnel. Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

programme.title: The Autobahn A2
programme.desc: Using the example of the 473-kilometre long Bundesautobahn 2 between Oberhausen and Berlin, the work of firefighters, doctors, police and customs is presented. On the highway there are also construction sites, rest areas and the work on roads and bridges is shown and portray tourists, travelers and truckers.

programme.title: Building Off the Grid
programme.desc: For many, an ideal existence is as far away from the bustling boulevards and city streets as is physically possible, opting to live in a serene and secluded corner of our planet. This documentary series follows teams of adventuring builders as they construct magnificent and unique properties in far-flung corners of our planet. Battling against adverse conditions, limited budgets and narrow deadlines, these crews strive to get their structures erected in time. From mountain cabins to woodland yurts, shipping container homes to lighthouse conversions, these stunning properties show the true meaning of living off the grid.

programme.title: Building Alaska
programme.desc: In one of the most remote and rugged places on the planet, expert hunting guide Bob May has led scores of outdoorsmen and adventurers during their dream trips on the Kenai Peninsula of Alaska. Now it's his turn to do some dreaming. Bob sets out to build the ultimate hunting lodge that will become his own piece of heaven on earth. But even the most rugged Alaskan needs some help from time to time. That's where his son and team of experts come in. Watch as they battle the elements and personal challenges to make a dream home a reality in DIY Network's Building Alaska.

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
programme.desc: Top chasers track a stunning tornado outbreak in eastern South Dakota. When a violent EF2 blows through a farmstead, Brandon and Tanner race to the scene. Connor gets his best tornado of the season as Jordan teaches his brother the art of the chase.

programme.title: Off the Hook: Extreme Catches
programme.desc: Pro wrestler "Showtime" Eric Young is on a journey into the world of extreme and unusual fishing. In the ring, Eric is a competitive fighter with a big personality. But in his free time, he loves to head out on the water to fish. Now, Eric is on a journey to meet and fish with the most unique fishermen he can find. Anglers who are risking it all... for the sake of the catch.

programme.title: Expedition Files
programme.desc: Over 80 years ago, a mysterious body was found on a beach, accompanied by only a cryptic note. The Trojan War and the Trojan Horse may not be mythical after all. And new evidence may prove Shakespeare didn't author his own works.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Gold Rush is a reality television series that follows the placer gold mining efforts of various family-run mining companies in boundless north of America. The series focuses on the work process in the conditions of permafrost and working relations between the participants. The show has 10 seasons altogether. In some episodes participants start the adventure and travel to Alaska to search for gold because of financial issues. They do not have any previous experience and have to learn on the job. Then there appears several gold mining teams that compete with each other. In some episodes the teams move to South America. Admire the courage and determination of the team members in their unstoppable desire to become rich.

programme.title: Sulle tehti tüng!
programme.desc: On tõenäoline, et kaldume aitama neid, kes meile meeldivad. Seekord teeb Nigel Latta inimestest rahamuulad ja ka romantika ei jää pettustest puutumata.

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Lenna talu
programme.desc: Külm talv on Lennale ja ta loomadele ränk. Küttepuud on kallid ja Lennal on müümiseks alles vaid naerisemoosi. Aga abi tuleb vahel sealt, kust seda kõige vähem ootad.

programme.title: BooSnoo!
programme.desc: BooSnoost saab tsirkuseartist ja ta annab imelise etenduse.

programme.title: Numbriklotsid
programme.desc: Numbriklotside rallil on kümme sõitjat, aga võidu saab koju viia ainult üks.

programme.title: Karu Karla
programme.desc: Vahva sari kolmeaastastest lastest ja nende parimast sõbrast Karu-Karlast. Karla on laste lemmikkaisukaru, kes ärkab ellu ainult siis, kui kedagi teist lähedal pole. Karla aitab väikestel põnnidel üle saada igasugustest hirmudest ja muredest, ning teeb seda parimal võimalikul viisil - killukese maagia ja kujutlusvõimega.

programme.title: Luise ja Oliver
programme.desc: Luise ja Oliver on õde ning vend, kes elavad oma tavalist õe ja venna elu. Mängivad põnevaid mänge, õpivad uusi teadmisi ja tunnevad huvi, kuidas maailmas asjad käivad. Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Robert Kõrvits, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Tuta asjad
programme.desc: Kas teadsid, et Tutale maitsevad väga pannkoogid? Täna teeb Tuta pannkoogitainast ja Rebane on tal abis. Aga kuhu jäi suur lusikas?

programme.title: Mystery Lane'i põnevad juhtumid
programme.desc: Selles osas oodatakse detektiive Wimbledoni staadionile, kus toimuvad koerte jooksuvõistlused. Ühe koera salapärane kadumine viib meie sõbrad hämaratesse telgitagustesse, et mitte öelda salakäikudesse...

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Tagurpidi jõgi
programme.desc: Rändurid satuvad Hiidmerel koos paljude teiste meremeestega lõksu üksikule saarele, mille kohal kummuva tohutu vikerkaare all valitseb väike isepäine kuri nõid, kelle käest pääsemine näib ilmvõimatu.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika!
programme.desc: Jan ja Kees loodavad oma uue isevärki hobiga korraliku varanduse kokku ajada, kuid paraku kipub minema vastupidi ja neid ähvardab kopsakas trahv.

programme.title: Lucas
programme.desc: Mida teha, kui perepea kaotab korraga mälu?

programme.title: Viis sõpra 4
programme.desc: Sel suvel sõidavad sõbrad Egiptusesse, kus Juliani, Dicki ja Anne isa organiseerib näitust. Viis sõpra satuvad peale röövlitele, kes üritavad ära viia 5000 aastat vana muumiat, ja viisiku kätte satub iidne kullast amulett.

programme.title: Suvelõpp Viljandis
programme.desc: "Ühte ütlen mina ja teile julgelt ennustan: te tehke kasvõi tina, kord lauljaks mina saan!" Just ja nõnda ja veel mitut moodi laulavad Viljandi muusikakooli laulustuudio Viva la Musica lapsed. Lauluõpetaja Hedi-Kai Pai, laulud arranžeeris Urmas Lattikas. Režissöör ja operaator Toorion Ojaperv, valgustaja Karl Hallik, helirežissöör Viljar Särekanno, produtsent Kadi Priske.

programme.title: Lenda minuga _ lennunduse kuldajastu
programme.desc: Lennureiside edulugu sai alguse 1920. aastatel, kui esimesed hulljulged huvilised kõrgustesse tuhisesid. Peagi selgus, et keskmine inimene eelistab teravatele elamustele mugavust ning esimeste biplaanide asemele ilmusid suletud salongiga reisilennukid. Suurim murrang tsiviillennunduses jõudis kätte aga pärast II maailmasõda ning sellest peale seostus lendamine juba jõukuse, elegantsi ja stiiliga.

programme.title: Kümme kaadrit
programme.desc: Kunstnikunime Navitrolla all tuntud Heiki Trolla näitab pilte oma kodusest fotoalbumist, aga loob ka stuudiopubliku silme all ühe üllatava maali. Saatejuht Kristjan Jõekalda. 10. augustil oli Heiki Trolla 56. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Vaat kes ka räägib
programme.desc: Väikemees Mikey peab õppima elama koos uue õega, samal ajal kui tema ema ja isa õpivad samuti teineteisega kooselamist. Režissöör Amy Heckerling. Osades Kristie Alley, John Travolta, Bruce Willis, Olympia Dukakis jt.

programme.title: Surm paradiisis
programme.desc: Neville arreteeriti pärast David Cartwrighti laiba leidmist. Asja tuleb uurima politsei sisekontrolliameti inspektor Karen Flitcroft, kes on Neville'i süüs veendunud, kuid meeskond usub oma ülemasse ja otsustab teda kaitsta. Selwyn alustab põhjalikku uurimist, kes võis Neville'i peale viha kanda ja teda mõrvas süüdi lavastada. Päevavalgele tuleb see, mida sõber Andy püüdis Neville'ile viimati öelda.

programme.title: Ob-la-di, Ob-la-da
programme.desc: Laulja, kes on vaikselt, aga mitte tähelepandamatult muusikuteed käies rõõmustanud oma kuulajaid. Külalisteks on pedagoog Väljataga õpilane Tallinna muusikakoolist Jakko Maltis ja tantsupedagoog Almer Jantsu. Stuudios musitseerivad Mare Väljataga ja kvintett. Saatejuht Reet Linna, režissöör Maire Radsin. Täna on Mare Väljataga 75. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Juliette Greco laulud
programme.desc: Juliette Greco laule esitab Mare Väljataga ja Teleraadiokomitee estraadiorkester Tõnis Kõrvitsa juhatusel. Jacques Prevert'i luulet loeb Kersti Kreismann. Saatejuht ja autor on Lauri Leesi. Režissöör Toomas Lasmann.

programme.title: Laulud vanas majas. Mare Väljataga
programme.desc: Lauljatari väike meeleolukontsert, mille tõid 1984. aastal teleekraanile režissöör Georg Jegorov, operaatorid Enn Valk ja Vaido Saar, helirežissöör Enn Laidre ning toimetaja Ela Tomson.

programme.title: Minu käpardist õnnehaldjas
programme.desc: Ühel hommikul ärgates ei suuda Maxie oma silmi uskuda - armas hambahaldjas Violetta, tiivad kenasti kokku seatud, uinub rahulikult nukumajas. Selgub, et tal on tähtis ülesanne - ta otsib piimahammast, mis tuleb haldjariiki viia. Aga häda on selles, et Violetta sattus inimeste maailma salaja, tegemata piimahammaste kättesaamise eksamit! Kuigi haldjakoolis hoiatati, et inimeste maailm on ohtlik, hakkas see Violettale väga meeldima! Siin on nii palju ennenägematuid, ennekuulmatuid ja magusaid asju! Eriti šokolaad!

programme.desc: Nutikas lammas Shaun on täiesti püsimatu loom, kes kaasab pidevalt oma kaaslasi kõiksugu sekeldustesse, pöörates kodufarmis kõik pea peale.

programme.title: Mystery Lane'i põnevad juhtumid
programme.desc: Selles osas tuleb neil aidata Templirüütlite aarde avastanud professorit ja tema papagoid, kellega aaret noolival pahalasel on kurjad plaanid.

programme.title: Suvelõpukontsert Pärnumaal
programme.desc: Pärnumaa lapsed ja noored tulid sooja suve lõpul koduõuele Treimani rannakülas, et laulda seal oma lemmiklaule. Muusikatoimetaja Toomas Voll, laulude arranžeeringud ja salvestus Urmas Lattikas, režissöör Toorion Ojaperv, juhtoperaator Meelis Mikker, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Ob-la-di, Ob-la-da

programme.title: Päev keemiata
programme.desc: Mõelgem korraks, mis juhtuks siis, kui ühel ilusal päeval lakkaksid kõik keemilised protsessid ja kaoksid nende resultaadid ning algaks muinasjutuline päev keemiata? Stsenarist Valdo Pant, operaator Anton Mutt, režissöör Leo Karpin.

programme.title: Teisikud
programme.desc: Muusikaline komöödia laulja Toomas Aringust ja rallisõitja Mati Uibost (Jaak Joala kaksikrollis), keda ajakirjanik Tiina Salum (Merle Talvik) peab välise sarnasuse tõttu üheks ning samaks inimeseks. Režissöör-lavastaja Leo Karpin, režissöör Lembit Ulfsak, operaator-lavastaja Aleksander Razumov.

programme.title: Ob-la-di, Ob-la-da
programme.desc: Stuudios meenutavad saate salvestamist režissöör Leo Karpin ja tollane režissööri abi Mare Bachman. Sekka videolõike tuntud artistide esinemistest. Saatejuht Reet Linna, režissöör Maire Radsin.

programme.title: Rütmiralli
programme.desc: Esinevad Palestra ja Jaak Joala ansambel, Tarmo Pihlap, Marju Länik ja Mahavok, Muusik Seif ja Tõnis Mägi, Karavan ja Karl Madis. Režissöör Leo Karpin, toimetaja Reet Linna.

programme.title: Lepitus
programme.desc: R: Joe Wright. O: James McAvoy, Keira Knightley. Palavaid tundeid tulvil armastusdraama, mis põhineb Ian McEwani samanimelisel romaanil. Parima filmimuusika Oscari ja Kuldgloobusega pärjatud ajaloodraama, kus saatuslik valetunnistus vallandab kolme noore inimese elus suure kaose. 1935. aasta lämmataval suvel vallandub majapidajanna poja Robbie ja mõisapreili Cecilia vahel kirglik armusuhe. Noormehesse samuti salaja armunud Cecilia noorem õde Briony süüdistab aga poissi alusetult kuriteos, mis viib noored lahku ja paiskab kõigi kolme elukäigud sünge teadmatuse suunas.

programme.title: Tallinna Moepäevad '89
programme.desc: Tallinna Moepäevad 1989, näeme moefantaasiat mitmel huvitaval teemal.

programme.title: Voodist voodisse
programme.desc: Meg on põhjas ära käinud. Lõpuks ometi tunnistab ta endale tõtt ja sõlmib iseendaga rahu. Ta palub Ginalt vabandust ja Elijah otsustab tema loo ära kuulata.

programme.title: Reeglid muutuvad
programme.desc: Haarav põnevusfilm edukast narkoärikast, kes on pannud piisavalt raha kõrvale ja kavatseb nüüd pensionile minna. Viimasel hetkel aga annab aga boss talle ülesande leida üles miljonäri kadunud tütar. Asja teeb veel keerulisemaks üks narkotehing, mille lahendamine tundub võimatuna. Aegamisi hakkavad aga kõik probleemid omavahel seostuma...
